method: Three serial Lighthouse 12.8.2 mobile samples; same settings as September 10 baseline. First sample overlapped the tail of the path smoke HTTP requests; no concurrent build or browser tests. Network and host conditions uncontrolled. Lab evidence, not field CWV.

conclusion: Initial HTML image discovery verified in all three runs; no Booking background API request. Simulated LCP regressed; performance acceptance remains open. Sample 2 modeled render delay is 5.89 seconds (67% of LCP); this identifies the phase, not a confirmed code root cause.

browser.scope: Live production; real CMS and image responses; mutation requests blocked; no submissions

browserProbeNote: Initial probe incorrectly counted blocked analytics POST requests as business writes. Corrected accounting to API mutations, retaining all non-read requests blocked; all eight cases passed. No CMS or enquiry writes.
